case.summary: Verdict: fraud, probability 0.91. The customer denies the $30.02 online transaction 3581141, which forms the entire candidate episode and exposure (a single-transaction chain, not a spree); the card-memory scorer rates it 0.86, well above the 0.28 model risk score, and no recurring-charge pattern covers it (only 4 prior matches, one short of the exception), so this is not read as the customer's own routine charge. No evidence request was needed. Recommended: create the case now (auto) and block the card, pending team-lead approval (L1, exposure ≤ $2,500).
